name: Grind 75 - Core 75
source_notes: The official tool describes Grind 75 as a customizable coding interview list and supports filtering/grouping by topic and difficulty and customizing available time.

The official About page currently describes a pool of 169 questions with the top 75 selected as Grind 75. The default 75-question view currently reports 24 Easy, 42 Medium and 9 Hard with an estimated 64 hours; the live site may change.
Treat the official tool as the source of truth. Do not hardcode difficulty counts or assume the list never changes. Save the imported source snapshot date and source order.

sprint_target.distribution: 25 practice days with 3 questions each, plus 5 review/mock days; adapt to daily capacity and question estimates
